entries.back_en: Say whatever you want, but if you touch them, it'll be the last thing you do.
Don't underestimate the power of insignificance, monster.
I knew you had picked up the other volcanic pendant. Melian, how could you? Why did you have to get involved in this alone? You don't need to prove anything!
Heh... Look at me... Always relying on you, as always. You must be tired of it. You should leave me here, I'll be less of a burden to you and the others.
entries.note: 'cansado' masc.; Sirfiel é feminina (ver _5), deveria ser 'cansada'.

entries.back_en: Never say that again! You know you're all I have left since mum and dad died. I don't want... I don't want the same to happen to you. Are you hearing me?!
I miss them too... Is that why they never ask me to join in? So you can take care of me?
No, idiot... It's because I only feel protected when you're near, because I know no one would worry about me the way you do.
I didn't know... I guess it's hard to talk about it. Looks like we only have each other, right?
Never do this to me again... From now on, we'll take care of each other, just as mum and dad would like. Deal?
Friend... You must stop him.
Sirfiel, it's important. Something terrible will happen if no one stops him.
entries.note: Erro gramatical: 'se ninguém detê-lo' → 'se ninguém o detiver'.

entries.back_en: I don't know what you've gotten into, but I can't send reinforcements here, nor do I have enough material for more amulets. Better be very cautious if you plan to face that monster and return in one piece.
entries.note: Gênero inconsistente: 'cuidadoso' masc. mas 'inteira' fem.; jogadora é feminina.

entries.back_en: I can't use this anymore. I'd like you to keep it and continue what we started. You know what's at stake...
You haven't let go of that orb since you found it. Will it be enough to save him?
Even in Terragaya, where it remained hidden for millennia.
I hope you know the consequences of what you avoided here...
If you're desperate enough to look for the Guardian, I'll tell you where he is.
Go east until you reach a large platform. On it, place this cube. It's a key. It'll take you to the place you're looking for.
Now it's up to you to fix this.

You inspired so much confidence in these little mortals, at least take them to the end. The plague's origin lies there. That's why I took the key, so no one could open the Guardian's chamber. But I imagine you knew that...
Soul... is...
No... more like a giant rodent...
You know... You're starting to become very annoying.
What will happen with the plague now if you don't destroy the tree? And why have you given that Human the key to Beigon?
Guess chest with rewaaard...
But if wrooong... must kiiill...
